A '''battalion''' of [[Clone scout trooper/Legends|clone scout troopers]] of the [[501st Legion]] were part of a [[Faie's battle group|battle group]] under the command of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Faie/Legends|Faie]].<ref name="EGTW Cut 9" /> Faie led [[Gender/Legends|his]] scout troopers under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]]. Some members donned [[Color/Legends|green]] camouflage while others retained their standard white [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="Republic 81">[[Republic 81|''Republic'' 81]]</ref>
